name: covdbg
description: C++ code coverage on Windows for AI agents. Run tests, find uncovered code, and add targeted tests. No rebuild required.
long_description:
covdbg measures C++ code coverage of the Windows x64 binaries you already build, using their PDB debug information. It works like a debugger: it starts your executable, reads the PDB, and places lightweight probes while the program runs, so no instrumented rebuild is needed.

The built-in MCP server lets a coding agent run coverage, rank files by uncovered lines, read the uncovered source segments with context, add a focused test, and re-run coverage to confirm the gap is closed. Coverage databases can be opened read-only, queried with SQL, and merged.

Requirements: Windows x64, covdbg 1.3.0 or newer installed (https://covdbg.com/download/), a one-time `covdbg login` (or a COVDBG_PROJECT_TOKEN for CI), and an executable with PDB symbols.
